title: kb_ask.py rows carry the kb sources its researcher cites
goal: A kb_ask.py run routed web or split writes `sources` on its spool row: the ids of the kb sources whose urls its researcher's answer names (normalised as in TK-mmrsjxct), never the urls or text; distill carries them into the entry and learn treats them like fetched pages; kb/_self/querylog.md's kb_ask row and entry keys name the field; TestLearnFalseNone covers a kb_ask row.

gates.question: May kb_ask.py rows and the stored entries gain `sources`, the kb source ids its researcher's answer cites (ids already in the kb, no urls or answer text), so learn sees a false none from kb_ask.py runs too?
options: Leave kb_ask.py rows as they are: detect from session fetches only
Record the answer's urls as host and path, like fetch rows

notes: kb_ask.py's claude -p runs with hooks off, so its fetches are never logged (querylog.md, Spool); the only trace of its researcher's pages is its answer, which kb_ask.py reads from the JSON `result` (claude/ci-and-headless.md:72, DOC S1800). The store is committed and pushed to origin, so a new entry field is the operator's call.
